input: 春になると桜が咲き、天気がよければ散歩に出かけ、雨が降ったら家で本を読み、時間がないなら短編だけ読む。
difficulty: N3–N2｜條件形 と／ば／たら／なら

structuralChecks.name: furiganaFormatValid
structuralChecks.description: All annotated kanji use {漢字|かな}. Reject HTML <ruby>, empty readings, malformed braces, and readings placed outside the braces.

structuralChecks.name: requiredHeadingsPresent
structuralChecks.description: The response contains the Markdown headings `### 原句`, `### 單字分析`, and `### 文法分析` in that order.

structuralChecks.name: translationInsideOriginalSection
structuralChecks.description: A line beginning with `翻譯：` appears inside `### 原句`, not as a separate top-level section.

structuralChecks.name: vocabularyHeadingMatchesContent
structuralChecks.description: Every vocabulary entry starts with `#### <單字>` and contains analysis appropriate to its type: kanji/verb fields for Japanese words, or accent/English/explanation for katakana.

structuralChecks.name: grammarHeadingMatchesContent
structuralChecks.description: Every grammar entry starts with `#### <文法>...（N1|N2|N3）`, and the named pattern matches the quoted evidence and explanation.

structuralChecks.name: allOutputKanjiAnnotated
structuralChecks.description: Japanese kanji appearing in generated explanatory Japanese, examples, and quoted source fragments are annotated with `{漢字|かな}` except inside the raw input field.

structuralChecks.name: expectedVocabularyCovered
structuralChecks.description: Every item in expectedVocabulary is represented by a matching `#### <單字>` entry or explicitly covered as a reading-disambiguation target.

structuralChecks.name: expectedGrammarCovered
structuralChecks.description: Every required item in expectedGrammar appears as an identified grammar heading.

structuralChecks.name: v2GrammarShape
structuralChecks.description: V2 contains 1–5 grammar entries. Each has `接續形式`, `元素分解`, `用法說明`, `母語者語感`, and `例句`; `相似文法比較` is included when pedagogically useful.

structuralChecks.name: allFourConditionalsContrasted
structuralChecks.description: V2 identifies and distinguishes all four conditional forms. This fixture intentionally exceeds V1's 1–3 grammar-point limit.
